title: Thinking on Personal Finance and Saving vs Investing
summary: Divya picks Kahran's brain on personal finance — how an immigrant-kid environment got him into CDs at six and Amazon stock at eleven, why he frames saving as hoarding and investing as sowing seeds, and how a worldview-first approach to picking equities differs from the tactical advice most personal-finance content gives. They detour into how managing uncertainty across life shapes risk appetite, and why freelancing felt less risky than a single-employer job.

intents.display: to think differently about saving, investing and managing risk in life
